Policy Name: Cigna Lumbar Fusion (CMM-609: Lumbar Fusion with Decompression)
Referred Sections: CMM-609.4: Lumbar Fusion (Arthrodesis) with Decompression (Indirect or Direct)
Second or Greater Recurrent Disc Herniation

Required findings: Individual is a candidate for lumbar decompression or lumbar corpectomy per CMM-608: Lumbar Decompression.

Imaging findings include degenerative spondylolisthesis without spondylolysis with EITHER dynamic segmental instability on flexion-extension plain x-rays OR comparison of a supine and upright image (difference in translational alignment >3mm) OR Meyerding Grade II or higher spondylolisthesis.

OR imaging findings include spondylolisthesis with spondylolysis (e.g., Isthmic Spondylolisthesis) with ANY of: Meyerding Grade I or II anterolisthesis with plain x-rays supporting progression; Meyerding Grade III or higher anterolisthesis with ≥50% anterior slippage OR plain x-rays supporting progression; progressive spinal pain without confirmatory imaging showing progression; multi-level spondylolysis on plain x-rays; post-operative instability from facet joint excision exceeding 50% bilaterally or 75% of a single facet; pars fracture; or previous spinal decompression resulting in iatrogenic spondylolisthesis.

Documentation of nicotine-free status: individual is a never-smoker OR has refrained from smoking, smokeless tobacco, and nicotine replacement therapy for at least six (6) weeks prior to surgery, validated by objective cotinine testing (serum, urinary, or saliva) within normal range.
Exception: When instability is created and/or identified intra-operatively, the above imaging criteria are NOT required.
Medical necessity indications.Source: CMM-609.4: Lumbar Fusion (Arthrodesis) with Decompression (Indirect or Direct) > Actual Instability (TOC: S7.1.1)

Required findings: Individual is a candidate for lumbar decompression or lumbar corpectomy per CMM-608: Lumbar Decompression.

Anticipated iatrogenic instability created by ANY of: disruption of posterior elements due to facet joint excision exceeding 50% bilaterally or 75% of a single facet during decompression; removal of the pars interarticularis requiring fusion; decompression for Meyerding Grade I or higher spondylolisthesis with foraminal stenosis; or complete or partial corpectomy (removal of at least one-third of the vertebral body, not for osteophyte resection alone).

Documentation of nicotine-free status: individual is a never-smoker OR has refrained from smoking, smokeless tobacco, and nicotine replacement therapy for at least six (6) weeks prior to surgery, validated by objective cotinine testing (serum, urinary, or saliva) within normal range.
Medical necessity indications.Source: CMM-609.4: Lumbar Fusion (Arthrodesis) with Decompression (Indirect or Direct) > Anticipated Iatrogenic Instability (TOC: S7.1.2)

Required findings: Individual is a candidate for lumbar decompression or lumbar corpectomy per CMM-608: Lumbar Decompression.

Imaging findings include EITHER coronal plane deformity (Cobb angle >30°, asymmetric disk collapse causing symptomatic foraminal narrowing, or global coronal imbalance causing head and trunk shift off midline) OR sagittal imbalance (sagittal vertebral axis measurement >8cm or pelvic incidence-lumbar lordosis >15°).

Documentation of nicotine-free status: individual is a never-smoker OR has refrained from smoking, smokeless tobacco, and nicotine replacement therapy for at least six (6) weeks prior to surgery, validated by objective cotinine testing (serum, urinary, or saliva) within normal range.
Medical necessity indications.Source: CMM-609.4: Lumbar Fusion (Arthrodesis) with Decompression (Indirect or Direct) > Adult Symptomatic Degenerative Spinal Deformity (TOC: S7.1.3)

Required findings: Individual is a candidate for an initial primary lumbar discectomy per CMM-606.2: Initial Primary Lumbar Microdiscectomy (Laminotomy, Laminectomy, or Hemilaminectomy) or CMM 606.1: General Guidelines.

Advanced imaging shows ANY of: primary extraforaminal disc herniation at L5-S1 where far lateral approach is not feasible due to iliac wings; primary foraminal disc herniation requiring facet resection for retrieval resulting in iatrogenic instability; or primary disc herniation at the level of the spinal cord (low lying conus medullaris).

Documentation of nicotine-free status: individual is a never-smoker OR has refrained from smoking, smokeless tobacco, and nicotine replacement therapy for at least six (6) weeks prior to surgery, validated by objective cotinine testing (serum, urinary, or saliva) within normal range.
Medical necessity indications.Source: CMM-609.4: Lumbar Fusion (Arthrodesis) with Decompression (Indirect or Direct) > Initial Disc Herniation (TOC: S7.1.4)

Required findings: Individual is a candidate for repeat lumbar discectomy per CMM 606.3: Repeat Lumbar Microdiscectomy (Laminotomy or Laminectomy) at the Same Level.

Imaging findings include evidence of anterolisthesis at the requested level(s) resulting in EITHER dynamic segmental instability on flexion-extension plain x-rays OR comparison of a supine and upright image (difference in translational alignment >3mm) OR Meyerding Grade II or higher spondylolisthesis.

Documentation of nicotine-free status: individual is a never-smoker OR has refrained from smoking, smokeless tobacco, and nicotine replacement therapy for at least six (6) weeks prior to surgery, validated by objective cotinine testing (serum, urinary, or saliva) within normal range.

Documentation of nicotine-free status: individual is a never-smoker OR has refrained from smoking, smokeless tobacco, and nicotine replacement therapy for at least six (6) weeks prior to surgery, validated by objective cotinine testing (serum, urinary, or saliva) within normal range.

Non-Indications: Patients who are not candidates for lumbar decompression or lumbar corpectomy per CMM-608: Lumbar Decompression.
Patients with degenerative spondylolisthesis without spondylolysis who do not have dynamic segmental instability (>3mm translation) or Meyerding Grade II or higher spondylolisthesis.

Patients with spondylolisthesis with spondylolysis who do not meet specific grading/progression criteria (e.g., Meyerding Grade I without progression, Meyerding Grade III without ≥50% slippage or progression, or lack of multi-level spondylolysis/pars fracture/iatrogenic history).

Patients with anticipated iatrogenic instability where the instability is not created by facet excision (>50% bilateral/75% single), pars removal, decompression for Grade I+ spondylolisthesis with foraminal stenosis, or corpectomy (≥1/3 vertebral body).
Patients with adult symptomatic degenerative spinal deformity who do not have coronal plane deformity (Cobb >30°, asymmetric collapse, global imbalance) or sagittal imbalance (axis >8cm, PI-LL >15°).

Patients with initial disc herniation who do not have specific anatomical constraints (L5-S1 extraforaminal with iliac wing interference, foraminal requiring facet resection, or low lying conus medullaris).
Patients with recurrent disc herniation (first recurrence) who do not have evidence of anterolisthesis with dynamic instability (>3mm) or Meyerding Grade II or higher spondylolisthesis.

Patients who have not refrained from smoking, smokeless tobacco, or nicotine replacement therapy for at least six (6) weeks prior to surgery, or whose objective cotinine testing is not within the normal range.
Patients who are smokers or use nicotine products without documented cessation and negative cotinine testing.
Important criteria & exceptions: Exception for Actual Instability: When instability is created and/or identified intra-operatively, the pre-operative imaging criteria for instability are NOT required.
Nicotine-free status must be validated by objective cotinine testing methods (serum, urinary, or saliva) verified as within the normal range for the specific testing method and lab.
Corpectomy for anticipated iatrogenic instability must involve removal of at least one-third of the vertebral body and is not covered for resection of osteophytes alone.
Facet joint excision causing instability must exceed 50% bilaterally or 75% or more of a single facet.
Documentation required: Objective cotinine testing results (serum, urinary, or saliva) verified as within normal range, or documentation of never-smoker status.
Flexion-extension plain x-rays or comparison of supine and upright images showing translational alignment difference >3mm (for Actual Instability or Recurrent Disc Herniation).
Plain x-rays supporting progression of anterolisthesis or showing multi-level spondylolysis/pars fracture (for Actual Instability).

Advanced imaging (MRI/CT) showing primary extraforaminal disc herniation at L5-S1, foraminal disc herniation requiring facet resection, or disc herniation at the level of the spinal cord (for Initial Disc Herniation).

Imaging findings demonstrating coronal plane deformity (Cobb angle, disk collapse, global imbalance) or sagittal imbalance (sagittal vertebral axis, pelvic incidence-lumbar lordosis) (for Adult Symptomatic Degenerative Spinal Deformity).
Documentation of candidate status for lumbar decompression or lumbar corpectomy per CMM-608: Lumbar Decompression.
Documentation of candidate status for initial primary lumbar discectomy per CMM-606.2 or CMM 606.1 (for Initial Disc Herniation).
Documentation of candidate status for repeat lumbar discectomy per CMM 606.3 (for Recurrent or Second or Greater Recurrent Disc Herniation).
